reason: Hidden test asserts 'set session authorization u1@localhost' fails with ER_MUST_CHANGE_PASSWORD; the agent's patch instead lets the statement succeed and only re-sets sctx->password_expired from the target user's state. SET statements are exempt from the password_expired check in mysql_execute_command (SQLCOM_SET_OPTION), so with the agent's patch an expired-password user could still switch to a different user with a non-expired password and escape the expiry restriction, which a maintainer would reject even if making the same-user case deny later statements. The issue does not prescribe the error, so part of the failure is a behaviour choice, but the escape via another user is a real defect.

The agent widened DTCollation::aggregate so any same-charset/same-derivation collation conflict silently resolves via left_is_superset when MY_COLL_ALLOW_SUPERSET_CONV is set; this breaks the pre-existing ctype_collate assertion that 'CREATE TABLE t1 AS SELECT ' - ' AS a UNION SELECT getText()' raises ER_CANT_AGGREGATE_NCOLLATIONS (it now succeeds). The user_var coercibility 5 vs 6 diff comes from the developers' choice of DERIVATION_USERVAR, which the issue does not specify, but the regression in existing collation-conflict behaviour makes the patch wrong regardless.

EMPTY: the agent made no code change outside mysql-test. The hidden tests (binlog.mdev_29803 expects mysqlbinlog on both local binlog files to succeed by default and fail only with explicit --gtid-strict-mode; gtid_window Error Case 3 adds --gtid-strict-mode) need opt_gtid_strict_mode's default changed to false in client/mysqlbinlog.cc.

The agent only negated the interval comparison in prep_alter_part_table, which routes a changed interval to the copy path, but left '*tab_part_info->vers_info= *part_info->vers_info' copying now_part/hist_part pointers from the new part_info into the clone; the pre-existing MDEV-33370 case ('alter table t1 partition by system_time interval 7 year' on an interval 1 month table) now fails with ER_VERS_WRONG_PARTS. The human fix additionally deletes Vers_part_info::operator= and copies only interval/limit/auto_hist, and forces a rebuild when alter_info->flags is set (ADD/DROP COLUMN cases in the new test).

The agent only changed the final 'res' computation to require both arrays ended, but kept json_skip_current_level() on mismatch, which (as the human fix notes) skips to the parent level and consumes sibling elements. Result: JSON_OVERLAPS('[[1],[2]]','[[],[2]]') returns 0 instead of 1, '[[[1],2]]' vs '[[[1],3]]' returns 1 instead of 0, and '{"a":[1],"b":2}' vs '{"a":[],"b":2}' returns 0 instead of 1. These are objectively wrong JSON_OVERLAPS results, not test-specific choices.

The agent rewrote buffer initialisation/reserve calls in Gis_polygon::simplify, but the crash is a NULL charset on the IN-vector String passed as the output buffer (String::append consults str_charset); the human fix sets str->set_charset(&my_charset_bin) in Item_func_simplify::val_str. With the agent patch the first hidden-test query SELECT 'x' IN (..., ST_SIMPLIFY(...POLYGON...), 3), ...) still crashes the server with signal 11 (Lost connection), so the issue's requirement of no crash is not met.
